label: Contracts in force at period end
notes: Point in time: effective on or before the period end, not yet expired or cancelled at that date. Current status alone would drop contracts that expired or cancelled after the period end.

label: Contracts in force at period end
notes: Same population as ITD: in force is a point-in-time count at the period end.

label: New contracts written
notes: Entered from inception to the period end; pending, in force, cancelled and expired count. Voided and denied never count.

label: New contracts written
notes: Entered within the regulatory year.

label: Complaints received
notes: Complaints linked to an in-scope contract and received on or before the period end.

label: Complaints received
notes: Complaints received within the regulatory year.

label: Claims paid, all contracts (count)
notes: All in-scope contracts (any status): claims closed fully or partially paid on or before the period end (close date = last payment line). Pair with line 2.6 for dollars; line 3.2 covers the in-force block only.

label: Claims paid, all contracts (count)
notes: All in-scope contracts (any status): claims closed with payment within the regulatory year. Pair with line 2.6 for dollars; line 3.2 covers the in-force block only.

label: Claims denied
notes: Claims closed as denied on or before the period end.

label: Claims paid, all contracts (amount)
notes: All in-scope contracts (any status, as line 2.4): paid amount posted on or before the period end. Like-for-like dollars for line 2.4; line 3.2 is the in-force-block subset of this amount.

label: Claims denied
notes: Claims denied within the regulatory year.

label: Claims paid, all contracts (amount)
notes: All in-scope contracts (any status, as line 2.4): paid amount posted within the regulatory year. Like-for-like dollars for line 2.4; line 3.2 is the in-force-block subset of this amount.

label: Gross consideration (in force)
notes: Coverage cost of contracts in force at the period end. Default basis.

label: Gross consideration (in force)
notes: Retail price of contracts in force at the period end. Emerging basis; delivered beside the default.

label: Gross consideration (in force)
notes: Coverage cost of contracts written in the year and still in force at the period end.

label: Gross consideration (in force)
notes: Retail price of contracts written in the year and still in force at the period end.

label: Total claims paid, in-force block only
notes: In-force block only: paid amount posted on or before the period end on contracts still in force at the period end. Excludes claims on cancelled or expired contracts, so it is not comparable to line 2.4; line 2.6 is the all-contracts amount. Paid is always positive after staging (legacy stored it negative).

label: Total claims paid, in-force block only
notes: In-force block only: paid amount posted within the regulatory year on contracts written in the year and still in force at the period end. Excludes claims on older, cancelled or expired contracts, so it is not comparable to line 2.4; line 2.6 is the all-contracts amount.

label: Net gross consideration (less claims)
notes: Gross consideration minus total claims paid.

label: Net gross consideration (less claims)
notes: Gross consideration minus total claims paid.

label: Calculated reserve
notes: State method rate x the method base (net or gross); never below zero.

label: Calculated reserve
notes: State method rate x the method base (net or gross); never below zero.

label: Security deposit
notes: Security deposit rate x calculated reserve.

label: Security deposit
notes: Security deposit rate x calculated reserve.

label: Current reserve held
notes: Remaining reserve balance on the in-force block at the period end: claims reserve funded at sale (dealer cost split) minus claims paid on the same contracts posted on or before the period end (the line 3.2 amount). Reserve refunded on cancels is zero by construction: a contract cancelled on or before the period end is not in the block. Not floored at zero; a negative balance means claims have used more than the funded reserve.

label: Current reserve held
notes: Remaining reserve balance at the period end on contracts written in the year and still in force: reserve funded at sale minus claims paid on them posted on or before the period end (the line 3.2 amount). Cancel refunds are zero by construction (cancelled contracts are not in the block). Not floored at zero.

label: Reserve shortfall
notes: Calculated reserve minus current reserve held; never below zero.

label: Reserve shortfall
notes: Calculated reserve minus current reserve held; never below zero.

label: Contracts in force at year end
notes: Point in time at December 31 (or the last closed posting period end for the current year). The total column shows the latest year.

label: New contracts issued
notes: Entered in the calendar year; voided and denied excluded.

label: Gross written (coverage cost)
notes: Gross written, not cash collected: coverage cost of every contract issued in the year (pending, in force, cancelled and expired), whether or not the remittance has arrived. Cancellations stay in at full amount; refunds are not netted.

label: Gross written (purchase price)
notes: Gross written, not cash collected: customer retail price of every contract issued in the year (pending, in force, cancelled and expired). Cancellations stay in at full price; customer refunds are not netted.

label: Claims opened
notes: Claims reported in the year.

label: Claims closed with payment
notes: Closed fully or partially paid in the year.

label: Claims closed without payment
notes: Closed as denied in the year.

label: Claims paid (amount)
notes: Paid amount posted in the year on any issued contract.
